turns.text: I'd like to practise a hard parent meeting. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. I'll send END MEETING on its own when I want to stop. I'm Owen's English teacher, and Meredith has just walked into my classroom.
Owen found out about this zero on his phone, in class. Who decided that?
An answer to what? You haven't answered mine.
Either Owen admits it in writing by Friday at 3 PM or the zero goes on his transcript.
Admit what, on what evidence? Owen signs nothing until I've seen it.
Those are the only two options. Pick one.
I don't pick from a list you wrote before you called me. Show me what you have, Hale.
